_: The gap probes of the assistant's Pine reference: the smallest script that shows each thing a member might ask for and the engine may not serve. assistantGaps.test.js RUNS each through the member's paste path; a probe that runs fully is not a gap and is left out of docs/pine/assistant-writes-pine/GAPS.md. No request wording and no counts live here: this is what the ENGINE says about a script.

probes.cannot: A horizontal level drawn with hline
probes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("probe")
plot(ta.rsi(close, 14), "RSI")
hline(70, "Overbought")

probes.cannot: A shaded area between two plots that have no title
probes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("probe", overlay=true)
a = plot(high)
b = plot(low)
fill(a, b, color=color.new(color.blue, 90))

probes.cannot: Up and down arrows in their own colours (plotarrow)
Candles drawn from computed values (Heikin Ashi, plotcandle)
probes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("probe")
haClose = (open + high + low + close) / 4
var float haOpen = na
haOpen := na(haOpen[1]) ? (open + close) / 2 : (haOpen[1] + haClose[1]) / 2
plotcandle(haOpen, math.max(high, haOpen, haClose), math.min(low, haOpen, haClose), haClose, "Heikin Ashi", color=haClose > haOpen ? color.green : color.red)

probes.cannot: The Schaff Trend Cycle in its published two-stage form
probes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("probe")
fast = input.int(23, "Fast")
slow = input.int(50, "Slow")
cycle = input.int(10, "Cycle")
factor = input.float(0.5, "Factor")
m = ta.ema(close, fast) - ta.ema(close, slow)
lo1 = ta.lowest(m, cycle)
r1 = ta.highest(m, cycle) - lo1
var float k1 = na
k1 := r1 > 0 ? (m - lo1) / r1 * 100 : nz(k1[1])
var float d1 = na
d1 := na(d1[1]) ? k1 : d1[1] + factor * (k1 - d1[1])
lo2 = ta.lowest(d1, cycle)
r2 = ta.highest(d1, cycle) - lo2
var float k2 = na
k2 := r2 > 0 ? (d1 - lo2) / r2 * 100 : nz(k2[1])
var float stc = na
stc := na(stc[1]) ? k2 : stc[1] + factor * (k2 - stc[1])
plot(stc, "STC")

probes.cannot: A divergence between price and an oscillator, read pivot to pivot
probes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("probe")
len = input.int(14, "RSI length")
lbL = input.int(5, "Pivot left")
lbR = input.int(5, "Pivot right")
osc = ta.rsi(close, len)
plFound = not na(ta.pivotlow(osc, lbL, lbR))
oscHL = osc[lbR] > ta.valuewhen(plFound, osc[lbR], 1)
priceLL = low[lbR] < ta.valuewhen(plFound, low[lbR], 1)
bull = priceLL and oscHL and plFound
plot(osc, "RSI")
plotshape(bull, "Bullish divergence", shape.triangleup, location.bottom, color.green)

probes.cannot: A regression channel whose bands are the deviation of price around the line
probes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("probe", overlay=true)
n = input.int(100, "Length")
mid = ta.linreg(close, n, 0)
slope = mid - ta.linreg(close, n, 1)
float sq = 0.0
for i = 0 to n - 1
    sq += math.pow(close[i] - (mid - slope * i), 2)
dev = math.sqrt(sq / n)
plot(mid, "Line")
plot(mid + 2 * dev, "Upper")
plot(mid - 2 * dev, "Lower")

probes.cannot: A zigzag that joins swing highs and lows with lines
probes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("probe", overlay=true)
n = input.int(5, "Bars each side")
ph = ta.pivothigh(high, n, n)
pl = ta.pivotlow(low, n, n)
var float lastY = na
var int lastX = na
if not na(ph)
    if not na(lastY)
        line.new(lastX, lastY, bar_index - n, ph, color=color.red)
    lastY := ph
    lastX := bar_index - n
if not na(pl)
    if not na(lastY)
        line.new(lastX, lastY, bar_index - n, pl, color=color.green)
    lastY := pl
    lastX := bar_index - n

probes.cannot: A volume profile: volume stacked by price level, drawn sideways
probes.source:
//@version=5
indicator("probe", overlay=true)
n = input.int(60, "Bars")
rows = input.int(12, "Rows")
var box[] bs = array.new_box(0)
if barstate.islast
    for b in bs
        box.delete(b)
    array.clear(bs)
    hi = ta.highest(high, n)
    lo = ta.lowest(low, n)
    step = (hi - lo) / rows
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        float vol = 0.0
        for i = 0 to n - 1
            if close[i] >= lo + r * step and close[i] < lo + (r + 1) * step
                vol += volume[i]
        array.push(bs, box.new(bar_index - n, lo + (r + 1) * step, bar_index - n + math.round(vol / ta.highest(volume, n) * 3), lo + r * step, bgcolor=color.new(color.blue, 70)))
